name: Khosmos
description: Quote + e-sign + invoicing + payments for French construction pros and micro-entreprises (1–50 people / subcontractors). Create a full quote in under a minute, sign on-site or remotely, then bill. ~€24/mo + per-seat, annual plans available.

mentions.evidence: ~$21.9k MRR, 834 active subscriptions, ~$24.8k L30, ~$355k all-time, ~12,000 users claimed, founded Mar 2023, France. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one country's trade invoicing/e-sign rules and own quote→pay end-to-end. Switching costs are high once invoices live there.

whyItPrints: Tradespeople lose deals when quotes are slow. Khosmos owns the quote→cash workflow in one country vertical — same shape as Conductor (legacy/ops glue) and Calendesk (country booking), but for French chantier admin.
whyThisMatters:
French building crews use Khosmos to get a quote signed on the job. You make it on a phone in under a minute. The client signs there, or you send it and they sign later. One click turns the signed quote into an invoice, and the invoice into a job report. It fits France's electronic invoicing rules. Signatures are free, with no cap. You get a notice when the client opens it.

The quote can open with reviews, photos of past jobs, decennial insurance, your terms, and a Google rating. They say that cover moves signed quotes from about 30 percent to above 50 percent. It's on the App Store and Google Play. There's also caller ID, a free directory listing, a planner where clients request a time, and a board for selling a firm or finding a subcontractor. Free helpers include a quote PDF, a VAT calculator, and a rough cost for an SASU, SARL, or EURL.

You pay monthly plus a seat, with yearly plans available. It's for firms of about one to 50 people, including subcontractors. It started in France in March 2023. They say more than 15,000 tradespeople are on it. Quote, signature, invoice, then you get paid.
